caption: The drawing depicts a single jug with a rounded body and a short, narrow neck, topped with a small opening and a handle attached at the side near the neck. The jug is predominantly colored in shades of brown and dark brown, with an irregular, textured, tree-bark-like pattern running vertically down its surface. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is an inset close-up of a rectangular section of the jug, showcasing a circular "R" mark surrounded by horizontal bands, all in similar brown tones. The jug is centered on a plain light background, with a faint rectangular border framing the composition, and the artist's name, Annie B. Johnston, appears in the lower right corner.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
